g.text: "هل أنت متأكد من طلب مساعدة طارئة؟"
Validate patient has no active SOS
Set platform price = 1.5x avg market price
"Nurse assigned — your emergency nurse is on the way"
Send "SOS Already Assigned" to remaining nurses
If no nurse accepts within 2 min:
- Option to retry or call emergency services
